title: Onboard orenda-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Add the Orenda-13B v1.0 model to the registry with production-ready metadata, validated performance profiles for our standard GPU classes, and automated changelog entries so product and platform teams can track releases. This PR includes: 1) model metadata (name, architecture, tokenizer, recommended batch sizes, quantization knobs), 2) perf profiles generated from the perf lab runs (latency/throughput for p3dn, a100-80g, and t4-like), 3) integration of the changelog automation script so onboards emit a standardized changelog entry under changelogs/models/ with model-specific release notes, and 4) a small test harness to validate the registry manifest. Checklist: - [x] metadata YAML schema validated - [x] perf profiles uploaded and referenced - [x] changelog automation hook added - [x] unit and integration tests updated - [x] docs entry in models/README.md updated Compat/rollout notes: This onboarding is non-breaking; default model alias is not exposed until the rollout task in Linear is completed (ENG-4123). The automated changelog uses the existing changelog template and will append an entry on merge. Testing notes: Run `./scripts/perf/ingest_perf_profiles.py --model orenda-13b --profiles perf_profiles/orenda-13b-v1.0.json` and `pytest tests/test_onboarding.py::test_orenda_metadata` locally. Perf baseline: median p99 latency on a100-80g: 42ms for 512-token prompt with dynamic batching; throughput numbers included in perf_profiles. Rollout plan: merge to main, tagging will be handled by release automation which will pick up the changelog entry.
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add orenda-13b v1.0 metadata and README snippet; 2) Add perf profile JSON produced by perf-lab and reference in registry index; 3) Hook changelog automation and add test for onboarding manifest.
